title: About

comments.author: Lori Sizemore
comments.text: Have you thought about making your comics available to purchase? For instance, posters, coffee mugs, mouse pads? Is that selling out? Because I’d like to buy something. And you might as well make some money off it. Even though you’ve got the meat-cutter at the grocery store thing, more money isn’t a bad thing.

comments.author: Faye Kirk
comments.text:
Dear b.patrick

I think your cartoons are inspirational in promoting mental health awareness. I am a Mental Health & Wellbeing Adviser for a University and wondered if you sell these comics or would you provide permission to use a couple for posters around the University? I think your comics would be a creative way to get students around the University to be more aware of mental health.

Thank you for your time.

Kind regards

comments.author: David Collett
comments.text:
It’s because your comics are too thoughtful and honest, rather than shit.

I rate you up there with the best!

comments.author: Abby Venga
comments.text: I only recently discovered your comics, and already I think your comics are very, very good. They’re insightful, eye-opening, and a lot of them are damn hilarious. I fail to see how anyone could anyone possibly think they are shit! Please, keep drawing and writing.

comments.author: Lu Zhao
comments.text: Greeting from China. Your work is beyond great. Please keep it up. You will make it. Btw you’re not alone. 🙂

comments.author: Quintn Parker
comments.text: Okay, this is kind of terrifying. I work as a meat cutter at my local grocery store and make comics on the internet in my spare time. Are you me? How did this happen?

comments.author: JayJay
comments.text: Just discovered your comics. They are entertaining, unique, thoughtful, and uncommon (which is a good thing). Thank you for the work that you do.

comments.author: Josh
comments.text: Holy crap shuttup and take my money! Your stuff is amazing! Always been aware of the depression/hand comic. Came here to see what else you had. SEND ME STUFF FOR 1 YEAR! HAZZAH!

comments.author: Alanel
comments.text: Amazing and intelligent stuff, I can hardly resist staying up all night just to finish reading all the comics you posted so far.

comments.author: Jo
comments.text:
Hey, I saw your comic on “being exactly who you want to be” on an image board, and found it incredibly interesting. At first I thought these comics are not well known because it’s a one hit wonder, but I was pleasently surprised to find each one to be so thought provoking… thank you! I really don’t know how you’re not being published by some big label, but your graph is spot on. Haven’t seen such quality in this sea of memes and cat videos since tales of mere existence. Don’t know how big your fanbase is at the moment but maybe you too should give Patreon.com a try!

You know that slightly depressing feeling when you wish you were powerful enough give people what they deserve?
